start_here: Say to your AI: "Make a test booking type called TEST pipeline, 30 minutes." It runs tool:create-a-tidycal-booking-type.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it changes one booking type on your TidyCal account.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI what the test type is for.
2. The AI calls tools:run with the tool and its input.
3. Read the answer and check the type's id before removing it.

worked_examples.title: tool:create-a-tidycal-booking-type
worked_examples.ask: Make a test booking type called TEST pipeline, auto-deleted, 15 minutes.

input.title: TEST pipeline, auto-deleted
input.description: Test type, deleted after the test

worked_examples.given: Reads tools/tidycal/what-this-tool-does-and-how-to-run-it.json: a POST to https://tidycal.com/api/booking-types with the vault key tidycal-api-token. The body is always private, free (price 0), not in the public directory (in_gallery_at null) and 30 days of availability; the caller gives only title, description, duration and url slug.
worked_examples.hands_back: It answers the new booking type with its id and url slug, for example id 9999999 with url slug test-pipeline-7k2q. Real values come from the live TidyCal answer.
